verdict.rationale: Square exposes broad APIs covering payments, catalog, inventory, locations, orders, disputes, payouts, webhooks, sandbox, and even an MCP server for AI agents, suggesting most core UI workflows are API-accessible. However, no evidence of a full OpenAPI spec (probes 404'd) or confirmation that every dashboard feature (e.g., payroll, team scheduling) is fully API-parity, leaving gaps for a true 'everything via API' claim.
